subject: RE: FW: AMSTERDAM SCHIPHOL - TNR / 41 CRATES 176 KGS
body:
Hi,

I’m arranging air freight for our buyer’s import into Toronto, CA. Could you quote an all-in price in EUR for the fastest option to YYZ, including pickup at our site in 28945 Bremen, Germany, and trucking to the departure airport?

The import shipment is 8 pieces of sports equipment, ready for pickup on 2026-11-25, with a gross weight of 121.26 lb and a volume of 16.25 cubic feet.

Mira Petersen
Nordlicht Audio


-----Original Message-----
Sent: 2026-10-02
Subject: AMSTERDAM SCHIPHOL - TNR / 41 CRATES 176 KGS

Dear team,

pls quote air freight ex AMSTERDAM SCHIPHOL to TNR:

FCA, cargo ready next week.

Thanks
